WatchHomePromo.title: Asɛm no nsesa. Nanso ɔkwan a nkurɔfo hwɛ no, ɛsesa.
WatchHomePromo.description: Yɛresan yɛ yɛn video library ne nnwinnade no fi ase koraa, na yɛde translation adwuma a wɔayɛ mfe pii no rema platforms a nkurɔfo wɔ hɔ dedaw, na wɔhwɛ na wɔkyɛ.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Fim library a wɔakyerɛ ase sen biara wɔ wiase
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Translation adwuma a wɔayɛ mfe pii, a ministry partners a wɔde wɔn ho to so na wɔakɔ so de aba, ayɛ library a ɛwɔ kasa tracks mpempem pii na nkurɔfo betumi ahu Yesu asɛm no wɔ kasa a ɛka wɔn koma sen biara mu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Yɛde nne a wobu wɔn ho so reba formats foforo mu

WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ɛnyɛ library nko ara. Ɔsom adwumayɛfo kuw.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project yɛ world-wide kuw a wɔkyerɛ kasa, media specialists, editors, ne creators a wɔresesa ministry experience a ɛwɔ mfe pii no ayɛ nnwinnade ma disciple-makers baabiara.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Ka viewers no bɔ mu ma wɔnya akwannya a ɛda wɔn honhom mu kwan so, na mmoa wɔn ma wɔmfa wɔn anammɔn a edi hɔ nkɔ community, Kyerɛwsɛm, anaa mission mu.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Christian media library kɛse a ɛwɔ videos, fim, ne resources mpempem pii a wɔwɔ kasa ahorow mu ma ministry ne evangelism wiase nyinaa.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, content distribution, audience engagement, ne analytics a wɔayɛ ama ministries atumi akɔ nkurɔfo pii so yie.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Boa ma <highlight>nkyirimma foforo</highlight> a wɔde mission tools bedi dwuma no nyɛ
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Yɛrefrɛ practitioners, creators, ne partners ma wɔnkɔ early access mu. Sɔ nnwinnade foforo no hwɛ kane, ma feedback, na boa yɛ products a wɔayɛ ama mission adwuma nokware mu.
